description: Erection of a 2 storeys dwellinghouse to deliver a 3-bed home, with associated cycle and refuse stores.
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed development, by reason of the lack of provision of affordable housing, would fail to adequately contribute towards the provision of mixed and balanced communities and housing need in the local area. As such, the development would be contrary to policy H4 (Delivering affordable housing) and H5 (Threshold approach to applications) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP12 (Meeting Housing Needs) and LP13 (Affordable Housing) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), Paragraph 64 of the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF 2024), and the guidance contained within the Hackney Planning Contributions SPD (2020).</p>

<p>In the absence of a suitable legal undertaking (Section 106 agreement) to secure that the occupiers of the new residential unit would be ineligible to apply for on-street parking permits within the Controlled Parking Zone (CPZ), the proposal would result in increased parking stress on the local highway network. Consequently, the development would have an adverse impact on local parking conditions, highway safety, and the promotion of sustainable modes of transport, contrary to policies T1 (Strategic approach to transport), and T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) of the London Plan (2021), and policies LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</p>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of a lack of sufficient energy efficiency measures and/or a legal agreement to secure a financial contribution towards off-site carbon offsetting, would fail to achieve the required reductions in carbon dioxide emissions. The proposal is therefore contrary to policy SI 2 (Minimising Greenhouse Gas Emissions) and SI 4&nbsp; (<span style="text-align: justify;">Managing heat risk) </span>of the London Plan (2021), policy LP54 (Overheating and Adapting to Climate Change) and policy LP55 (Mitigating Climate Change) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within the Hackney Sustainable Design and Construction SPD (2016).</p>

<p>The proposed development would result in the unjustified loss of existing car parking for Dalston Works, including essential Blue Badge provision, without demonstrating adequate or safe reprovision. Furthermore, the applicant has failed to demonstrate that the replacement Blue Badge space/s and retained pedestrian access routes can operate safely and comfortably, or that the operational access to adjoining properties will not be compromised. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies T6 (Car parking) and T6.1 (Residential parking) of the London Plan (2021) and policies&nbsp;<span style="text-align: justify;">LP43 (Transport and development) and&nbsp;</span><span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development</span><span style="text-align: justify;">) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (LP33) (2020).</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-6c363d81-7fff-78c9-80a0-54a670680b5c"></span><span style="text-align: justify;"><br></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-0e177623-7fff-3e2d-7dd6-59af9416a1cc"></span><br></p>

<p>The proposed development, by reason a lack of information concerning the siting and specification, including noise outputs for the proposed Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP), fails to demonstrate that the equipment would not generate unacceptable levels of noise and vibration. The proposal risks causing undue noise disturbance to the detriment of the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers, contrary to policy D14 (Noise) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (LP33) (2020).</p>

<p>The proposed development is a piecemeal and ad hoc form of development that is out of keeping with and fails to reinforce local high quality design.&nbsp; As such, it fails to be&nbsp;compatible with the existing townscape including urban grain and plot division and&nbsp;<span style="text-align: justify;">degrades the layout and separation of two existing developments, adversely affecting the urban grain and spatial development of the wider area, contrary to policies D1 (London's form, character and capacity for growth), </span><span style="text-align: justify;">D3 (</span><span style="text-align: justify;">Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach)&nbsp;</span><span style="text-align: justify;">and D4 (Delivering good design) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (</span><span style="text-align: justify;">Design Quality and Local Character)</span><span style="text-align: justify;"> and LP17  (Housing design) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025). </span></p>
